messages:
nora: running into a surprising crash in the async python SDK when the server returns a validation 422 with a weird encoding and a string-escaped errors field. client tries await resp.json() and we get UnicodeDecodeError; we also lose the raw bytes so oncall is blind. stack: ```Traceback (most recent call last): File "app/handler.py", line 66, in run resp = await client.messages.create(payload) File "/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood_async/client.py", line 198, in create return await resp.json() File "/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/aiohttp/client_reqrep.py", line 1128, in json return loads(body.decode(encoding)) UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x93 in position 120```

patrick: two problems: (1) assuming utf-8 unconditionally, (2) not preserving raw_body/raw_text on async errors (sync already does). We should avoid calling .json() blindly and ensure exceptions expose the bytes/text.

samir: agreed. suggested approach: check content-type heuristics, try json only when likely, otherwise read bytes and decode with cp1252 fallback. always attach exception.raw_body (bytes) and exception.raw_text (decoded str) for parity. also include a short snippet in exception.__str__ to help logs.

nora: can we ship a small patch release? this is blocking our incident runbooks. happy to validate.

ciara-bot: [ticket-bot] Created RN-PLAT-529: async sdk - preserve raw response and fallback charset handling.

samir: I'll draft PR with unit tests that simulate cp1252 HTML and problem+json cases and assert exception.raw_body is bytes and raw_text is str. will also add docs example for safe logging.

nora: thanks, assigning myself to validate the patch on staging once CI passes. :thumbsup:
